name: Arx Libertatis
description:
Arx Libertatis is a cross-platform, open-source port of Arx Fatalis, the 2002 first-person action role-playing game developed by Arkane Studios. Based on the officially released source code, Arx Libertatis modernizes the engine to run smoothly on contemporary hardware.

Features:
- Full widescreen display support with arbitrary resolution rendering
- Modernized mouse-look controls, field of view adjustments, and UI scaling
- Fixed game-breaking bugs and physics glitches present in the original release
- Native audio output using OpenAL with environmental reverberation effects
- Full compatibility with the original game data and community localized versions
